title.description: The main name of the book.
title.pdf: Exported to PDF metadata as the core Title value. If a subtitle is present, the PDF Title becomes Title: Subtitle.
title.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Title value. If a subtitle is present, the EPUB title becomes Title: Subtitle.
title.mp4: Exported to MP4 metadata as the Title tag. If a subtitle is present, the MP4 title becomes Title: Subtitle.
title.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as the Title value. If a subtitle is present, the ZIP title becomes Title: Subtitle.

subtitle.description: A secondary line that adds context, tone, or a clarifying phrase to the title.
subtitle.pdf: Appended to the title in PDF metadata, producing Title: Subtitle.
subtitle.epub: Appended to the title in EPUB metadata, producing Title: Subtitle.
subtitle.mp4: Appended to the MP4 title tag, producing Title: Subtitle.
subtitle.zip: Appended to the title in the ZIP archive comment and ZIP manifest files, producing Title: Subtitle.
subtitle.example: Pocket-sized catastrophe management for the holidays

author.description: The person, collective, or organization responsible for the work. Use this for credited creators and contributors.
author.pdf: Exported to PDF metadata as the Author value.
author.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Creator value.
author.mp4: Exported to MP4 metadata as the Artist tag.
author.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as the Author value.

pubDate.description: The publishing or release date associated with this edition. It helps with citations, export metadata, and edition tracking.
pubDate.pdf: Not exported into a dedicated PDF field, but it can be folded into fallback Subject text when no explicit Subject or Description is provided.
pubDate.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Date value.
pubDate.mp4: Exported to MP4 metadata as the Date tag when the value can be parsed as a real date.
pubDate.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as the Date value.

publisher.description: The press, imprint, label, or organization that published the book.
publisher.pdf: Can be included in fallback Subject and Keywords metadata.
publisher.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Publisher value.
publisher.mp4: Included in the MP4 Comment tag alongside other catalog notes.
publisher.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as the Publisher value.

language.description: The primary language used in the book's content.
language.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Language value. If Region is present, the two are combined into a locale tag such as en-US.
language.mp4: Exported to MP4 track metadata as a language code. Common 2-letter values such as en are converted to a 3-letter code such as eng.
language.zip: Exported into the ZIP manifest files as the language value. If Region is present, the two are combined into a locale tag such as en-US.

region.description: A regional locale code that refines the language when that matters for cataloging or export metadata.
region.epub: Used with Language to build the EPUB language tag, such as en-US.
region.zip: Used with Language to build the ZIP manifest language tag, such as en-US.

subject.description: A short human-readable topic or category phrase.
subject.pdf: Exported to PDF metadata as the Subject value when present.
subject.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as a Subject value.
subject.mp4: Exported to MP4 metadata as the Genre tag.
subject.zip: Exported into the ZIP manifest files as a subject term.

description.description: A brief summary, blurb, or catalog note explaining what the book is about.
description.pdf: Used as the PDF Subject fallback when Subject is blank.
description.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Description value.
description.mp4: Exported to MP4 metadata as the Description tag.
description.zip: Exported into the ZIP manifest files as the description value.
description.example: A tiny handbook of festive corners cut, avoidable accidents, and cheerful workplace dread.

keywords.description: Search-friendly words or phrases that help describe the book in exports and future discovery tools. Separate terms with commas.
keywords.pdf: Exported to PDF metadata as Keywords, then merged with core terms like title, author, publisher, subject, and classification.
keywords.epub: Split into individual terms and exported to EPUB metadata as additional Subject entries.
keywords.mp4: Included in the MP4 Comment tag alongside other catalog notes.
keywords.zip: Exported into the ZIP manifest files as keywords, and also merged into subject-style terms where appropriate.

classification.description: The shelving or taxonomy code used to place the book within your classification system.
classification.pdf: Can be included in fallback Subject and Keywords metadata.
classification.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as an additional Subject entry when present.
classification.mp4: Included in the MP4 Comment tag alongside other catalog notes.
classification.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as a subject-style classification term.

cityPublished.description: The city associated with publication or release. Useful for formal colophons and bibliographic records.

copyright.description: A short copyright statement for this edition.
copyright.epub: Exported to EPUB metadata as the Rights value.
copyright.mp4: Included in the MP4 Comment tag alongside other catalog notes.
copyright.zip: Included in the ZIP archive comment and exported into the ZIP manifest files as the Rights value.

isbn.description: A 10-digit International Standard Book Number, usually used for older editions.
isbn.epub: Used as the EPUB package identifier when ISBN-13 is not present.
isbn.zip: Used as the ZIP manifest identifier when ISBN-13 is not present.

isbn13.description: A 13-digit International Standard Book Number used by modern publishing workflows and retailers.
isbn13.epub: Preferred as the EPUB package identifier when present.
isbn13.zip: Preferred as the ZIP manifest ISBN and identifier when present.

edition.description: A note naming the edition or release state of the book.

phone.description: A phone number connected to the publisher, imprint, or contact line listed in the book.

website.description: A publisher, author, or project website related to the book.

address.description: A mailing or business address for the publisher, imprint, or contact block.
address.example:
123 Little Press Lane
Saint Paul, MN 55101

email.description: An email address for the publisher, author, or contact block.

copyrightNotice.description: A fuller legal or rights statement that can be placed on the copyright page.
copyrightNotice.example: No part of this publication may be reproduced without prior written permission, except for brief quotations in reviews.

creditsDisclaimer.description: A note for contributor credits, acknowledgments, content warnings, or disclaimers.
creditsDisclaimer.example: Names have been changed, rumors remain unverified, and every typo belongs to the editor.

seriesName.description: The name of the series this book belongs to, if any.

number.description: The numbered position of the book within a series or sequence.

volume.description: The volume designation for a multi-volume work.

printing.description: A note describing the printing state of this physical release.

custom.description: A flexible field for anything not covered by the built-in book info fields.
